text: Told everyone saves? They saved less.
Peer pressure should work, right? Watch.
A big American manufacturing company, 2008. Workers who weren't saving got a simple form.
Tick one box. Start saving six percent.
Some letters added one line: join the coworkers your age who already save.
Without that line, nine point nine percent of one group signed up.
Lower earners pulled back most. Seeing everyone ahead can feel like: why bother?
So compare with last month's you. Not with everyone else.
